messages:
samir: Quick question — if I go on an unpaid LOA (medical) that starts Dec 10, which is before our year-end carryover cutoff, will I keep my unused PTO carryover into next year or does the LOA block that? I can probably start the LOA paperwork this week.

Marina (People Ops): Short answer: we usually make an exception for medically documented leaves. Longer answer: it depends on timing and whether the leave is classified as FMLA/STAT-qualifying.

Marina (People Ops): Steps for you: 1) Submit the LOA intake form (https://hr.redwood.example/loa-intake) — pick the medical option and attach the doctor's note. 2) We put a hold on the carryover deadline while we review the LOA case. 3) If approved (FMLA or comparable), Payroll will preserve accrued carryover and make a retro adjustment if needed.

Marina (People Ops): Please cc your manager so we can confirm coverage and expected return date. If it's unpaid and under 6 months, we typically preserve accruals; beyond that we escalate to benefits and legal.

Lindsay: @samir I can help with the manager sign-off. Ping me once you submit and I’ll approve coverage and temporary reassignments. :thumbsup:

samir: Thanks — submitted the intake just now (case #123456). Is there any specific payroll code I should include?

HR Bot: LOA intake received for samir. Case 123456 created. Next steps: People Ops will reach out in 1–2 business days to confirm docs. Reference code: LOA-2023-123456.

Marina (People Ops): Payroll code: `MED-LOA` for unpaid medical. For retro carryover adjustments we file an off-cycle with Payroll. If you want, I can open the off-cycle once the LOA is approved — just confirm here.

samir: Appreciate it, Marina. Please open the off-cycle if approved. Also asking because the year-end blackout means I can’t book PTO before Dec 20, so worried about losing days.

Marina (People Ops): Got it — we’ll flag the blackout as an exception in your case if the LOA overlaps it and the docs support it. One more thing: keep all medical documentation; benefits will need it for the FMLA determination.

Lindsay: Happy to step in on coverage planning. LMK if you want me to draft a short handoff doc for the team.

samir: That would be awesome, thanks.

Marina (People Ops): Follow-up: I’ll email you both once Benefits completes the review. If approved, carryover will appear on your Jan pay statement (or earlier if Payroll can process off-cycle). :white_check_mark:
